raw_segments.text: Brutus, are yet two Romans living such as these. The last of all the Romans, fare thee
well. It is impossible that ever Rome should breed thy fellow. Friends, I owe more tears
to this dead man than you shall see me pay. I shall find time, Cassius, I shall find time.
Come therefore, and Tathassos send his body. His funerals shall not be in our camp lest
it discomfort us. Lucilius, come, and come, young Cotto, let us to the field. Labeo and
Flavius set our battles on. Tease three o'clock, and Romans, yet ere night we shall try fortune
